title: StageManifest
description: Machine-readable interface for one ledger stage. Extracted from the stage LaTeX + audit scripts; consumed by the composite build (checks C1-C8, see MANIFEST_README).

stage_id.description: Stable stage identifier, e.g. stage030. Namespace root for claim_refs.

part.description: Ledger part anchor, e.g. 'Part IV -- Charge (IV-1)'.

status_token.description: The stage's terminal verdict token, verbatim, e.g. ELECTRIC_SCALAR_CLOSURE_STATIC or R1_REQUIRED(bc_selection).

symbols.description: Every free symbol appearing in any expression in this manifest. Local names must not collide with another stage's symbol unless defined_in points there (check C1).

claims.description: All postulates, conventions, earned/derived identities, no-gos, and adjudications the stage asserts.

consumes.description: Upstream claims this stage uses. Each is CAS-diffed against the producer (check C2). Using an upstream result without a consumes entry is the decorative-dependency failure mode.

exports.description: Claim ids downstream stages may consume. Consuming a non-exported claim is a build error (check C3).

knobs.description: Free-parameter drift accounting. The composite knob census sums these against the global registry (check C5).

departures.description: Characterized departures and carried deferrals, by token.

dim.description: (L, M, T) exponent triple as exact rationals -- the ordering used by the ledger's dual-engine audit scripts (their BASE_DIMS convention). Base units: length L = ["1","0","0"], mass M = ["0","1","0"], time T = ["0","0","1"]. Disambiguating example: a_B = M L^-2 T^-2 = ["-2","1","-2"]. Dimensionless is ["0","0","0"]. NOTE: parameter_register.md's header prints [L,T,M]; manifests standardize on the verified scripts' (L,M,T). See manifests/DIM_ORDER_DECISION.md.

name.description: SymPy-parseable identifier. One name, one meaning, across the whole ledger.

defined_in.description: 'here' if this stage introduces the symbol; otherwise the defining stage. A symbol used here but defined elsewhere MUST have a matching consumes entry for its defining claim.

sympy.description: Canonical form. Must parse under sympy_parser with the manifest symbol table as local_dict, no implicit multiplication, exact rationals only (float atoms are a build error). Function whitelist in MANIFEST_README.

claim_id.description: Stable slug, unique within the stage.

status.description: EARNED/DERIVED claims are exact within holds_within. CALIBRATED marks target-matched values (analog-sufficiency legitimate, never blind evidence).

holds_within.description: The closure(s) conditioning this claim. An EARNED claim with empty holds_within asserts unconditional validity -- rare; the extractor should treat it as suspicious.

genesis.description: REQUIRED when status is POSTULATED, CONV, or CALIBRATED (enforced by check C8).

discharged_by.description: If a later stage converts this postulate to a theorem, the deriving claim. Discharge changes downstream citations, not this claim's own status history.

retired_by.description: Decision reference for RETIRED claims, e.g. 'Decision 16 (2026-07-21)'.

origin.description: independent: written without knowledge of the structure that later derives/matches it. coordinated: chosen to fit an already-known structure. target_matched: chosen to reproduce a known physical value. unknown: predates genesis tracking. 'unknown' is honest; a false 'independent' is the one lie this system exists to prevent.

as_consumed.description: The expression as this stage uses it. Check C2 asserts CAS-equivalence with the producer's statement -- symbolic simplify-to-zero, never string match.

action.description: introduced: new freedom enters here. inherited: cited from upstream, not double-counted. retired: removed by decision. discharged: converted from free to derived (e.g. K4 free -> wall-fixed).

mutation.description: Mutation env value that must make this predicate FIRE_AT_OWN_ASSERT.

teeth.description: Per-stage teeth, mapped to the claims they defend. Cross-stage teeth (check C7) are generated by the composite build from the consumes graph, not listed here.
